lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧ ਪਠਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਨਾਹੀ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: saadh pathaae aap har ham tum te naahee door ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself sent His Holy Saints, to tell us that He is not far away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੈ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਰਮਣ ਰਾਮ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhram bhai mit gae raman raam bharapoor ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, doubt and fear are dispelled, chanting the Name of the all-pervading Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਤਿ ਸਿਸੀਅਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਮੰਘਰ ਪੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: rut siseear seetal har pragate ma(n)ghar pohi jeeu ||
lines.translation: In the cold season of Maghar and Poh, the Lord reveals Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਨਿ ਬੁਝੀ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਧ੍ਰੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jalan bujhee daras paaiaa binase maaiaa dhroh jeeu ||
lines.translation: My burning desires were quenched, when I obtained the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; the fraudulent illusion of Maya is gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਕਾਮ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਹਜੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸੇਵਕਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh kaam poore mil hajoore har charan sevak seviaa ||
lines.translation: All my desires have been fulfilled, meeting the Lord face-to-face; I am His servant, I serve at His feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਰ ਡੋਰ ਸੀਗਾਰ ਸਭਿ ਰਸ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haar dor seegaar sabh ras gun gaau alakh abheviaa ||
lines.translation: My necklaces, hair-ties, all decorations and adornments, are in singing the Glorious Praises of the unseen, mysterious Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਜਮੁ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜੋਹਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau bhagat govi(n)d baa(n)chhat jam na saakai johi jeeu ||
lines.translation: I long for loving devotion to the Lord of the Universe, and so the Messenger of Death cannot even see me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਹ ਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak prabh aap melee tah na prem bichhoh jeeu ||6||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, God has united me with Himself; I shall never suffer separation from my Beloved again. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਡੋਲਤ ਨਾਹੀ ਚੀਤ ॥
lines.transliteration: har dhan paaiaa sohaaganee dolat naahee cheet ||
lines.translation: The happy soul bride has found the wealth of the Lord; her consciousness does not waver.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sa(n)jogee naanakaa grihi pragate prabh meet ||1||
lines.translation: Joining together with the Saints, O Nanak, God, my Friend, has revealed Himself in my home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੋਡ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਨੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naad binod ana(n)d kod pri preetam sa(n)g bane ||
lines.translation: With her Beloved Husband Lord, she enjoys millions of melodies, pleasures and joys.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਭਨੇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: man baa(n)chhat phal paaiaa har naanak naam bhane ||2||
lines.translation: The fruits of the mind's desires are obtained, O Nanak, chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਮਕਰ ਰੁਤਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਤੀ ਮਾਘੁ ਫਗਣੁ ਗੁਣਵੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: himakar rut man bhaavatee maagh phagan gunava(n)t jeeu ||
lines.translation: The snowy winter season, the months of Maagh and Phagun, are pleasing and ennobling to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਗਾਉ ਮੰਗਲੋ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਆਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakhee sahelee gaau ma(n)galo grihi aae har ka(n)t jeeu ||
lines.translation: O my friends and companions, sing the songs of joy; my Husband Lord has come into my home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਲਾਲ ਆਏ ਮਨਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਸੇਜ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸੋਹੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: grihi laal aae man dhiaae sej su(n)dar soheeaa ||
lines.translation: My Beloved has come into my home; I meditate on Him in my mind. The bed of my heart is beautifully adorned.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਭਏ ਹਰਿਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਮੋਹੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: van trin tribhavan bhae hariaa dekh darasan moheeaa ||
lines.translation: The woods, the meadows and the three worlds have blossomed forth in their greenery; gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, I am fascinated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਇਛ ਪੁੰਨੀ ਮਨਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਮੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mile suaamee ichh pu(n)nee man japiaa niramal ma(n)t jeeu ||
lines.translation: I have met my Lord and Master, and my desires are fulfilled; my mind chants His Immaculate Mantra.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਰਲੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸ੍ਰੀਧਰ ਕੰਤ ਜੀਉ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak nit karahu raleeaa har mile sreedhar ka(n)t jeeu ||7||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, I celebrate continuously; I have met my Husband Lord, the Lord of excellence. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok ||
lines.translation: Salok:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਭਵਜਲ ਤਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)t sahaaee jee ke bhavajal taaranahaar ||
lines.translation: The Saints are the helpers, the support of the soul; they carry us cross the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh te ooche jaaneeahi naanak naam piaar ||1||
lines.translation: Know that they are the highest of all; O Nanak, they love the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਤਰੇ ਸੇ ਸੂਰੇ ਸੇ ਬੀਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin jaaniaa seee tare se soore se beer ||
lines.translation: Those who know Him, cross over; they are the brave heroes, the heroic warriors.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਉਤਰੇ ਤੀਰ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tin balihaaranai har jap utare teer ||2||
lines.translation: Nanak is a sacrifice to those who meditate on the Lord, and cross over to the other shore. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛੰਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: chha(n)t ||
lines.translation: Chhant:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਬਿਰਾਜਿਤ ਸਭ ਊਪਰੇ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan biraajit sabh oopare mitiaa sagal kales jeeu ||
lines.translation: His feet are exalted above all. They eradicate all suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਵਣ ਦੁਖ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕੀਆ ਪਰਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaavan dukh hare har bhagat keeaa paraves jeeu ||
lines.translation: They destroy the pains of coming and going. They bring loving devotion to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਾਤੇ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬੀਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ra(n)g raate sahaj maate til na man te beesarai ||
lines.translation: Imbued with the Lord's Love, one is intoxicated with intuitive peace and poise, and does not forget the Lord from his mind, even for an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਜਿ ਆਪੁ ਸਰਣੀ ਪਰੇ ਚਰਨੀ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣ ਜਗਦੀਸਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: taj aap saranee pare charanee sarab gun jagadeesarai ||
lines.translation: Shedding my self-conceit, I have entered the Sanctuary of His Feet; all virtues rest in the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਿ ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਆਦਿ ਕਉ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: govi(n)d gun nidh sreera(n)g suaamee aad kau aades jeeu ||
lines.translation: I bow in humility to the Lord of the Universe, the treasure of virtue, the Lord of excellence, our Primal Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੋ ਇਕ ਵੇਸੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੮॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: binava(n)t naanak maiaa dhaarahu jug jugo ik ves jeeu ||8||1||6||8||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; throughout the ages, You take the same form. ||8||1||6||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਦਖਣੀ ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee mahalaa 1 dakhanee oa(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, First Mehl, Dakhanee, Ongkaar:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਉਤਪਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar brahamaa utapat ||
lines.translation: From Ongkaar, the One Universal Creator God, Brahma was created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar keeaa jin chit ||
lines.translation: He kept Ongkaar in his consciousness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੈਲ ਜੁਗ ਭਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar sail jug bhae ||
lines.translation: From Ongkaar, the mountains and the ages were created.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਨਿਰਮਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: oa(n)kaar bed niramae ||
lines.translation: Ongkaar created the Vedas.
